title: 城市生活与乡村生活，你喜欢哪个？

topic.en: city life is better than country life
topic.zh: 城市生活是否比乡村生活好

position.en: city life is better for me
position.zh: 城市生活更适合我

r1.en: city life saves travel time
r1.zh: 城市生活节省出行时间

x1.en: shops and schools are usually nearby
x1.zh: 商店和学校通常就在附近

e1.en: I can walk to a shop in five minutes
e1.zh: 我走五分钟就能到商店

c1.en: this helps me save time
c1.zh: 这帮助我节省时间

r2.en: it is easier to get medical help in cities
r2.zh: 在城市更容易得到医疗帮助

x2.en: there are more hospitals nearby
x2.zh: 附近有更多医院

e2.en: I can reach a hospital quickly when I feel ill
e2.zh: 我不舒服时可以很快到医院

c2.en: this makes my life easier
c2.zh: 这让我的生活更方便

opening.en: Whether city life is better than country life has been widely discussed. Although country life is quiet, I believe city life is better for me because city life saves travel time and it is easier to get medical help in cities.
opening.zh: 关于“城市生活是否比乡村生活好”已有很多讨论。虽然乡村生活很安静，但我认为城市生活更适合我，因为城市生活节省出行时间，而且在城市更容易得到医疗帮助。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, city life saves travel time.
body1.zh: 城市生活节省出行时间。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because shops and schools are usually nearby.
body1.zh: 这是因为商店和学校通常就在附近。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I can walk to a shop in five minutes.
body1.zh: 例如，我走五分钟就能到商店。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps me save time.
body1.zh: 这帮助我节省时间。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, it is easier to get medical help in cities.
body2.zh: 在城市更容易得到医疗帮助。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because there are more hospitals nearby.
body2.zh: 这是因为附近有更多医院。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, I can reach a hospital quickly when I feel ill.
body2.zh: 例如，我不舒服时可以很快到医院。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This makes my life easier.
body2.zh: 这让我的生活更方便。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe city life is better for me because city life saves travel time and it is easier to get medical help in cities.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为城市生活更适合我，因为城市生活节省出行时间，而且在城市更容易得到医疗帮助。

title: 名人是否要放弃隐私

topic.en: famous people should give up their privacy
topic.zh: 名人是否应该放弃隐私

although.en: fans want to know about their lives
although.zh: 粉丝想了解他们的生活

position.en: famous people should keep their privacy
position.zh: 名人应该保留隐私

r1.en: privacy helps them rest
r1.zh: 隐私帮助他们休息

x1.en: they need quiet time after work
x1.zh: 他们工作后需要安静的时间

e1.en: a singer can rest at home without cameras outside
e1.zh: 歌手可以在家休息，外面没有相机拍摄

c1.en: this helps the singer feel less stressed
c1.zh: 这帮助歌手减轻压力

r2.en: privacy protects their family life
r2.zh: 隐私保护他们的家庭生活

x2.en: their children also need a normal life
x2.zh: 他们的孩子也需要正常生活

e2.en: an actor can take a child to school without being followed
e2.zh: 演员可以不被跟拍地送孩子上学

c2.en: this makes family life easier
c2.zh: 这让家庭生活更轻松

opening.en: Whether famous people should give up their privacy has been widely discussed. Although fans want to know about their lives, I believe famous people should keep their privacy because privacy helps them rest and privacy protects their family life.
opening.zh: 关于“名人是否应该放弃隐私”已有很多讨论。虽然粉丝想了解他们的生活，但我认为名人应该保留隐私，因为隐私帮助他们休息，而且隐私保护他们的家庭生活。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, privacy helps them rest.
body1.zh: 隐私帮助他们休息。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because they need quiet time after work.
body1.zh: 这是因为他们工作后需要安静的时间。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, a singer can rest at home without cameras outside.
body1.zh: 例如，歌手可以在家休息，外面没有相机拍摄。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps the singer feel less stressed.
body1.zh: 这帮助歌手减轻压力。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, privacy protects their family life.
body2.zh: 隐私保护他们的家庭生活。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because their children also need a normal life.
body2.zh: 这是因为他们的孩子也需要正常生活。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, an actor can take a child to school without being followed.
body2.zh: 例如，演员可以不被跟拍地送孩子上学。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This makes family life easier.
body2.zh: 这让家庭生活更轻松。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe famous people should keep their privacy because privacy helps them rest and privacy protects their family life.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为名人应该保留隐私，因为隐私帮助他们休息，而且隐私保护他们的家庭生活。

title: 年龄限制

topic.en: young people should wait until 25 to drive
topic.zh: 年轻人是否应等到25岁才能开车

position.en: 18 is a suitable age to start driving
position.zh: 18岁是开始开车的合适年龄

r1.en: young people need time to learn road safety
r1.zh: 年轻人需要时间学习道路安全

x1.en: they must understand traffic rules before driving
x1.zh: 他们开车前必须理解交通规则

e1.en: I took driving lessons at 18 and learned to check my mirrors
e1.zh: 我18岁时上驾驶课，学会查看后视镜

c1.en: this helped me drive more safely
c1.zh: 这帮助我更安全地开车

r2.en: driving at 18 makes daily life easier
r2.zh: 18岁可以开车让日常生活更方便

x2.en: young adults need to travel to school or work
x2.zh: 年轻成年人需要去上学或上班

e2.en: I drove to college instead of waiting for a bus
e2.zh: 我开车去大学，不用等公交

c2.en: this helped me save time
c2.zh: 这帮助我节省时间

opening.en: Whether young people should wait until 25 to drive has been widely discussed. Although driving can be dangerous, I believe 18 is a suitable age to start driving because young people need time to learn road safety and driving at 18 makes daily life easier.
opening.zh: 关于“年轻人是否应等到25岁才能开车”已有很多讨论。虽然开车可能有危险，但我认为18岁是开始开车的合适年龄，因为年轻人需要时间学习道路安全，而且18岁可以开车让日常生活更方便。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, young people need time to learn road safety.
body1.zh: 年轻人需要时间学习道路安全。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because they must understand traffic rules before driving.
body1.zh: 这是因为他们开车前必须理解交通规则。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I took driving lessons at 18 and learned to check my mirrors.
body1.zh: 例如，我18岁时上驾驶课，学会查看后视镜。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helped me drive more safely.
body1.zh: 这帮助我更安全地开车。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, driving at 18 makes daily life easier.
body2.zh: 18岁可以开车让日常生活更方便。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because young adults need to travel to school or work.
body2.zh: 这是因为年轻成年人需要去上学或上班。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, I drove to college instead of waiting for a bus.
body2.zh: 例如，我开车去大学，不用等公交。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helped me save time.
body2.zh: 这帮助我节省时间。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe 18 is a suitable age to start driving because young people need time to learn road safety and driving at 18 makes daily life easier.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为18岁是开始开车的合适年龄，因为年轻人需要时间学习道路安全，而且18岁可以开车让日常生活更方便。

note: 开车统一选18岁。问25岁限制，就说不必等到25岁；问最低年龄，就明确回答18岁。

title: 国家把钱花在建筑修复，而非现代住房

topic.en: governments should spend money on old buildings
topic.zh: 政府是否应该花钱保护古建筑

position.en: old buildings should be protected, but new homes also need money
position.zh: 古建筑应该保护，但新住房也需要资金

r1.en: old buildings help people learn history
r1.zh: 古建筑帮助人们学习历史

x1.en: people can see how others lived in the past
x1.zh: 人们能看到过去的人怎样生活

e1.en: I visited an old house and saw an old kitchen
e1.zh: 我参观古老住宅，看到了旧式厨房

c1.en: this helped me understand life in the past
c1.zh: 这帮助我理解过去的生活

r2.en: building repairs can leave less money for new homes
r2.zh: 修复建筑可能挤占新住房的资金

x2.en: governments cannot spend the same money twice
x2.zh: 政府不能把同一笔钱花两次

e2.en: an expensive repair project may leave no money for new flats
e2.zh: 昂贵的修复工程可能使政府没钱建新公寓

c2.en: this can make it harder to provide enough homes
c2.zh: 这可能使政府更难提供足够住房

opening.en: Whether governments should spend money on old buildings has been widely discussed. Although new homes are also needed, I believe old buildings should be protected, but new homes also need money because old buildings help people learn history and building repairs can leave less money for new homes.
opening.zh: 关于“政府是否应该花钱保护古建筑”已有很多讨论。虽然人们也需要新住房，但我认为古建筑应该保护，但新住房也需要资金，因为古建筑帮助人们学习历史，而且修复建筑可能挤占新住房的资金。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, old buildings help people learn history.
body1.zh: 古建筑帮助人们学习历史。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because people can see how others lived in the past.
body1.zh: 这是因为人们能看到过去的人怎样生活。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I visited an old house and saw an old kitchen.
body1.zh: 例如，我参观古老住宅，看到了旧式厨房。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helped me understand life in the past.
body1.zh: 这帮助我理解过去的生活。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, building repairs can leave less money for new homes.
body2.zh: 修复建筑可能挤占新住房的资金。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because governments cannot spend the same money twice.
body2.zh: 这是因为政府不能把同一笔钱花两次。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, an expensive repair project may leave no money for new flats.
body2.zh: 例如，昂贵的修复工程可能使政府没钱建新公寓。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This can make it harder to provide enough homes.
body2.zh: 这可能使政府更难提供足够住房。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe old buildings should be protected, but new homes also need money because old buildings help people learn history and building repairs can leave less money for new homes.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为古建筑应该保护，但新住房也需要资金，因为古建筑帮助人们学习历史，而且修复建筑可能挤占新住房的资金。

note: 第二段是保护古建筑的好处，第三段是资金取舍的坏处；问到住房时，用第三段回应住房。

title: 法律改变人的行为

topic.en: laws can change people's behaviour
topic.zh: 法律是否可以改变人的行为

position.en: laws can change behaviour
position.zh: 法律可以改变行为

r1.en: punishment can stop people from breaking rules
r1.zh: 惩罚可以阻止人们违反规则

x1.en: people do not want to pay fines
x1.zh: 人们不想交罚款

e1.en: drivers may slow down when speeding leads to a fine
e1.zh: 超速会被罚款时，司机可能减速

c1.en: this can make roads safer
c1.zh: 这可以让道路更安全

r2.en: laws tell people what they must do
r2.zh: 法律告诉人们必须做什么

x2.en: clear rules make the right action easier to understand
x2.zh: 清楚的规则使人更容易知道该怎么做

e2.en: drivers stop at red lights because the rule is clear
e2.zh: 司机在红灯时停车，因为规则很清楚

c2.en: this helps people behave properly
c2.zh: 这帮助人们正确行动

opening.en: Whether laws can change people's behaviour has been widely discussed. Although some people still break laws, I believe laws can change behaviour because punishment can stop people from breaking rules and laws tell people what they must do.
opening.zh: 关于“法律是否可以改变人的行为”已有很多讨论。虽然有些人仍然违法，但我认为法律可以改变行为，因为惩罚可以阻止人们违反规则，而且法律告诉人们必须做什么。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, punishment can stop people from breaking rules.
body1.zh: 惩罚可以阻止人们违反规则。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because people do not want to pay fines.
body1.zh: 这是因为人们不想交罚款。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, drivers may slow down when speeding leads to a fine.
body1.zh: 例如，超速会被罚款时，司机可能减速。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This can make roads safer.
body1.zh: 这可以让道路更安全。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, laws tell people what they must do.
body2.zh: 法律告诉人们必须做什么。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because clear rules make the right action easier to understand.
body2.zh: 这是因为清楚的规则使人更容易知道该怎么做。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, drivers stop at red lights because the rule is clear.
body2.zh: 例如，司机在红灯时停车，因为规则很清楚。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps people behave properly.
body2.zh: 这帮助人们正确行动。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe laws can change behaviour because punishment can stop people from breaking rules and laws tell people what they must do.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为法律可以改变行为，因为惩罚可以阻止人们违反规则，而且法律告诉人们必须做什么。

title: 政府应该改善公共交通还是多修路

topic.en: governments should improve public transport rather than build more roads
topic.zh: 政府是否应该优先改善公共交通而不是多修路

position.en: public transport should come first
position.zh: 应该优先改善公共交通

r1.en: public transport saves people money
r1.zh: 公共交通帮助人们省钱

x1.en: bus fares can cost less than driving and parking
x1.zh: 公交票价可能比开车和停车的费用低

e1.en: I spend three dollars on a bus instead of ten dollars on parking
e1.zh: 我花三元坐公交，不用花十元停车

c1.en: this helps me save money
c1.zh: 这帮助我省钱

r2.en: public transport can reduce traffic
r2.zh: 公共交通可以减少拥堵

x2.en: one bus can carry many people
x2.zh: 一辆公交车能载很多人

e2.en: a full bus can replace many cars
e2.zh: 一辆满载的公交可以代替很多汽车

c2.en: this can make the roads less crowded
c2.zh: 这可以让道路不那么拥挤

opening.en: Whether governments should improve public transport rather than build more roads has been widely discussed. Although more roads can help drivers, I believe public transport should come first because public transport saves people money and public transport can reduce traffic.
opening.zh: 关于“政府是否应该优先改善公共交通而不是多修路”已有很多讨论。虽然更多道路能帮助司机，但我认为应该优先改善公共交通，因为公共交通帮助人们省钱，而且公共交通可以减少拥堵。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, public transport saves people money.
body1.zh: 公共交通帮助人们省钱。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because bus fares can cost less than driving and parking.
body1.zh: 这是因为公交票价可能比开车和停车的费用低。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I spend three dollars on a bus instead of ten dollars on parking.
body1.zh: 例如，我花三元坐公交，不用花十元停车。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps me save money.
body1.zh: 这帮助我省钱。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, public transport can reduce traffic.
body2.zh: 公共交通可以减少拥堵。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because one bus can carry many people.
body2.zh: 这是因为一辆公交车能载很多人。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, a full bus can replace many cars.
body2.zh: 例如，一辆满载的公交可以代替很多汽车。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This can make the roads less crowded.
body2.zh: 这可以让道路不那么拥挤。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe public transport should come first because public transport saves people money and public transport can reduce traffic.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为应该优先改善公共交通，因为公共交通帮助人们省钱，而且公共交通可以减少拥堵。

title: 家长需要为孩子的行为负法律责任吗

topic.en: parents should share legal responsibility for their children's actions
topic.zh: 家长是否应为孩子的行为承担部分法律责任

although.en: parents cannot watch children all the time
although.zh: 家长不能一直看着孩子

position.en: parents should share responsibility when their young children cause harm
position.zh: 年幼孩子造成伤害时，家长应分担责任

r1.en: parents can teach children basic rules
r1.zh: 家长可以教孩子基本规则

x1.en: young children learn from adults at home
x1.zh: 年幼孩子会向家里的成年人学习

e1.en: a parent can teach a child not to damage other people's things
e1.zh: 家长可以教孩子不破坏别人的东西

c1.en: this helps children behave better
c1.zh: 这帮助孩子表现得更好

r2.en: responsibility makes parents pay more attention
r2.zh: 承担责任让家长更留意

x2.en: parents may act earlier when they notice a problem
x2.zh: 家长发现问题时可能更早采取行动

e2.en: a parent can stop a child from throwing stones at windows
e2.zh: 家长可以阻止孩子向窗户扔石头

c2.en: this helps prevent damage
c2.zh: 这帮助防止损坏

opening.en: Whether parents should share legal responsibility for their children's actions has been widely discussed. Although parents cannot watch children all the time, I believe parents should share responsibility when their young children cause harm because parents can teach children basic rules and responsibility makes parents pay more attention.
opening.zh: 关于“家长是否应为孩子的行为承担部分法律责任”已有很多讨论。虽然家长不能一直看着孩子，但我认为年幼孩子造成伤害时，家长应分担责任，因为家长可以教孩子基本规则，而且承担责任让家长更留意。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, parents can teach children basic rules.
body1.zh: 家长可以教孩子基本规则。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because young children learn from adults at home.
body1.zh: 这是因为年幼孩子会向家里的成年人学习。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, a parent can teach a child not to damage other people's things.
body1.zh: 例如，家长可以教孩子不破坏别人的东西。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps children behave better.
body1.zh: 这帮助孩子表现得更好。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, responsibility makes parents pay more attention.
body2.zh: 承担责任让家长更留意。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because parents may act earlier when they notice a problem.
body2.zh: 这是因为家长发现问题时可能更早采取行动。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, a parent can stop a child from throwing stones at windows.
body2.zh: 例如，家长可以阻止孩子向窗户扔石头。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps prevent damage.
body2.zh: 这帮助防止损坏。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe parents should share responsibility when their young children cause harm because parents can teach children basic rules and responsibility makes parents pay more attention.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为年幼孩子造成伤害时，家长应分担责任，因为家长可以教孩子基本规则，而且承担责任让家长更留意。

title: 要不要限定最高薪资

topic.en: there should be a maximum wage
topic.zh: 是否应该设置最高工资

although.en: some people earn much more than others
although.zh: 有些人的收入远高于其他人

position.en: there should not be a maximum wage
position.zh: 不应该设置最高工资

r1.en: higher pay can encourage hard work

position.en: modern media have both good and bad sides
position.zh: 现代传媒既有好处也有坏处

r1.en: media help people learn useful information

x1.en: news can reach many people quickly

e1.en: I check the weather news before leaving home

c1.en: this helps me plan my day
c1.zh: 这帮助我安排一天

r2.en: false information can confuse people

x2.en: some stories are shared before anyone checks them

opening.en: Whether modern media bring both benefits and problems has been widely discussed. Although getting information is easier now, I believe modern media have both good and bad sides because media help people learn useful information and false information can confuse people.
opening.zh: 关于“现代传媒是否既有好处也有问题”已有很多讨论。虽然现在获取信息更容易，但我认为现代传媒既有好处也有坏处，因为传媒帮助人们了解有用信息，而且错误信息可能误导人们。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, media help people learn useful information.
body1.zh: 传媒帮助人们了解有用信息。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because news can reach many people quickly.
body1.zh: 这是因为新闻能很快传给很多人。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I check the weather news before leaving home.
body1.zh: 例如，我出门前查看天气新闻。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps me plan my day.
body1.zh: 这帮助我安排一天。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, false information can confuse people.
body2.zh: 错误信息可能误导人们。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because some stories are shared before anyone checks them.
body2.zh: 这是因为有些消息未经核实就被传播。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, someone may change travel plans because of a false train notice.
body2.zh: 例如，有人可能因假的列车通知改变出行计划。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This can waste people's time.
body2.zh: 这可能浪费人们的时间。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe modern media have both good and bad sides because media help people learn useful information and false information can confuse people.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为现代传媒既有好处也有坏处，因为传媒帮助人们了解有用信息，而且错误信息可能误导人们。

note: 一利一弊：得到信息更快，也可能被错误信息误导。

title: 欠发达国家的旅游业利弊相当

topic.zh: 旅游是否给较贫穷国家带来同样多的利与弊

position.en: tourism has both clear benefits and serious problems
position.zh: 旅游既有明显好处，也有严重问题

r1.en: tourism creates local jobs
r1.zh: 旅游创造当地工作岗位

x1.en: visitors need food and places to stay
x1.zh: 游客需要食物和住宿

e1.en: a small hotel can hire local people to clean rooms
e1.zh: 小旅馆可以雇当地人打扫房间

c1.en: this helps local people earn money
c1.zh: 这帮助当地人赚钱

r2.en: tourism can damage local places
r2.zh: 旅游可能损害当地环境

x2.en: too many visitors can leave rubbish behind
x2.zh: 太多游客可能留下垃圾

e2.en: a popular beach may be covered with empty bottles

opening.en: Whether tourism brings as many problems as benefits to poorer countries has been widely discussed. Although tourism brings money, I believe tourism has both clear benefits and serious problems because tourism creates local jobs and tourism can damage local places.
opening.zh: 关于“旅游是否给较贫穷国家带来同样多的利与弊”已有很多讨论。虽然旅游会带来收入，但我认为旅游既有明显好处，也有严重问题，因为旅游创造当地工作岗位，而且旅游可能损害当地环境。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, tourism creates local jobs.
body1.zh: 旅游创造当地工作岗位。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because visitors need food and places to stay.
body1.zh: 这是因为游客需要食物和住宿。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, a small hotel can hire local people to clean rooms.
body1.zh: 例如，小旅馆可以雇当地人打扫房间。

body1.zh: 这帮助当地人赚钱。

body2.zh: 旅游可能损害当地环境。

body2.label: 解释

body2.zh: 这是因为太多游客可能留下垃圾。

body2.zh: 例如，热门海滩可能到处都是空瓶子。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This makes the area a worse place to live.
body2.zh: 这让当地变得不那么适合居住。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe tourism has both clear benefits and serious problems because tourism creates local jobs and tourism can damage local places.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为旅游既有明显好处，也有严重问题，因为旅游创造当地工作岗位，而且旅游可能损害当地环境。

note: 一利一弊。采取折中观点：就业收入是好处，环境破坏是坏处，很难说只有一面。

title: 日用消费品的营销应该重品牌还是重优惠

topic.en: companies should focus on their name or on discounts
topic.zh: 公司应该重视品牌还是折扣

position.en: companies should focus more on a trusted name
position.zh: 公司应该更重视可信的品牌

r1.en: a trusted name makes buying easier
r1.zh: 可信的品牌让购买更容易

x1.en: people worry less about the quality
x1.zh: 人们较少担心质量

e1.en: I buy the same brand of milk because I know its quality
e1.zh: 我买同一个牌子的牛奶，因为我了解它的质量

c1.en: this helps me choose quickly
c1.zh: 这帮助我快速选择

r2.en: good quality brings customers back
r2.zh: 好质量会让顾客再次购买

x2.en: a useful product gives people a reason to buy again

e2.en: I buy the same shoes again because the first pair lasted well

opening.en: Whether companies should focus on their name or on discounts has been widely discussed. Although discounts can attract buyers quickly, I believe companies should focus more on a trusted name because a trusted name makes buying easier and good quality brings customers back.
opening.zh: 关于“公司应该重视品牌还是折扣”已有很多讨论。虽然折扣能快速吸引买家，但我认为公司应该更重视可信的品牌，因为可信的品牌让购买更容易，而且好质量会让顾客再次购买。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, a trusted name makes buying easier.
body1.zh: 可信的品牌让购买更容易。

body1.label: 解释

body1.zh: 这是因为人们较少担心质量。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps me choose quickly.
body1.zh: 这帮助我快速选择。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, good quality brings customers back.
body2.zh: 好质量会让顾客再次购买。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because a useful product gives people a reason to buy again.
body2.zh: 这是因为好用的产品让人有再次购买的理由。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, I buy the same shoes again because the first pair lasted well.
body2.zh: 例如，第一双鞋很耐穿，所以我又买了同款。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps the company keep customers.
body2.zh: 这帮助公司留住顾客。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe companies should focus more on a trusted name because a trusted name makes buying easier and good quality brings customers back.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为公司应该更重视可信的品牌，因为可信的品牌让购买更容易，而且好质量会让顾客再次购买。

title: 员工参与决策的利弊

topic.zh: 员工是否应该参与公司决策

r1.zh: 员工可以提出有用的想法

body1.zh: 员工可以提出有用的想法。

body1.label: 解释

body1.zh: 这是因为他们每天处理工作中的实际问题。

body1.zh: 这可以让购物更方便。

body2.zh: 更多意见可能让决策变慢。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe letting workers help can bring good ideas but take more time because employees can suggest useful ideas and more opinions can slow decisions.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为让员工参与能带来好想法，但会花更多时间，因为员工可以提出有用的想法，而且更多意见可能让决策变慢。

body2.zh: 商场让价格更容易比较。

body2.zh: 这是因为顾客可以很快逛几家商店。

body2.zh: 例如，我在附近两家店比较一件衬衫的价格。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps me save money.
body2.zh: 这帮助我省钱。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe shopping malls can improve daily shopping because shopping malls save travel time and shopping malls make prices easier to compare.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为商场可以改善日常购物，因为商场节省出行时间，而且商场让价格更容易比较。

title: 气候变化谁负责

topic.en: governments should take the main responsibility for climate change

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe learning by doing helps students learn because doing a task makes it easier to remember and practice builds useful skills.

opening.en: Whether travel is necessary for a good education has been widely discussed. Although travel can teach useful things, I believe a good education does not require travel because students can learn well at local schools and online lessons bring learning to people's homes.
opening.zh: 关于“旅行是否是良好教育的必要条件”已有很多讨论。虽然旅行能教人有用的东西，但我认为获得良好教育并不一定需要旅行，因为学生可以在本地学校学得很好，而且网络课程把学习带到人们家里。

body1.label: 理由

body1.zh: 学生可以在本地学校学得很好。

body1.label: 解释

body1.zh: 这是因为本地老师也能讲解相同的基础科目。

body1.zh: 例如，我在家附近的学校学习数学。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This shows that learning does not require travel.
body1.zh: 这说明学习不一定需要旅行。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, online lessons bring learning to people's homes.
body2.zh: 网络课程把学习带到人们家里。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because students can watch teachers from other places.
body2.zh: 这是因为学生能观看其他地方老师的课程。

body2.label: 例子

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps me learn without leaving home.
body2.zh: 这帮助我足不出户地学习。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe a good education does not require travel because students can learn well at local schools and online lessons bring learning to people's homes.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为获得良好教育并不一定需要旅行，因为学生可以在本地学校学得很好，而且网络课程把学习带到人们家里。

note: 问旅行必要性：不必旅行也能学好；问留学被高估：不必出国也能学好。两个理由共用。

body1.en: This showed that I needed more practice.
body1.zh: 这说明我需要更多练习。

body2.en: Second, exam results help students plan their study.
body2.zh: 考试结果帮助学生安排学习。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because wrong answers show what needs more work.
body2.zh: 这是因为错误答案显示哪些地方需要加强。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, I reviewed the questions I got wrong after an exam.
body2.zh: 例如，考试后我复习了做错的题。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helped me improve my learning.
body2.zh: 这帮助我改进学习。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe written exams are useful because exams show what students understand and exam results help students plan their study.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为笔试有用，因为考试显示学生理解了什么，而且考试结果帮助学生安排学习。

although.zh: 学生可能遇到实际困难

c1.zh: 扣少量分数帮助规则保持公平

opening.en: Whether universities should take marks off for late work has been widely discussed. Although students can have real problems, I believe schools should take off a few marks, but give extra time for real problems because deadlines should be fair to all students and schools should allow extra time for real problems.
opening.zh: 关于“大学是否应该对迟交作业扣分”已有很多讨论。虽然学生可能遇到实际困难，但我认为学校应该扣少量分数，但实际困难应允许延期，因为截止日期应对所有学生公平，而且学校应为实际困难允许延期。

body1.label: 本段重点
body1.en: First, deadlines should be fair to all students.
body1.zh: 截止日期应对所有学生公平。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because students who finish on time should not be treated worse.
body1.zh: 这是因为按时完成的学生不应受到不利对待。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I submit work on time while another student asks for extra days without a reason.
body1.zh: 例如，我按时交作业，另一名学生却无理由要求多几天。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: Taking off a few marks helps keep the rules fair.
body1.zh: 扣少量分数帮助规则保持公平。

body2.label: 本段重点
body2.en: Second, schools should allow extra time for real problems.
body2.zh: 学校应为实际困难允许延期。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because illness can stop students from finishing work.
body2.zh: 这是因为生病可能使学生无法完成作业。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, a student in hospital may need a few extra days.
body2.zh: 例如，住院的学生可能需要多几天。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This helps students finish work without unfair punishment.
body2.zh: 这帮助学生完成作业，避免不公平的惩罚。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe schools should take off a few marks, but give extra time for real problems because deadlines should be fair to all students and schools should allow extra time for real problems.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为学校应该扣少量分数，但实际困难应允许延期，因为截止日期应对所有学生公平，而且学校应为实际困难允许延期。

note: 第二段表达扣分观点，第三段给出允许合理延期的建议。

opening.en: Whether universities should replace paper books with digital books has been widely discussed. Although digital books are useful, I believe universities should use digital books but keep some paper books because digital books can save printing costs and digital books are hard to use without a working device.
opening.zh: 关于“大学是否应该用电子书替代纸质书”已有很多讨论。虽然电子书有用，但我认为大学应该用电子书，但也保留一些纸质书，因为电子书可以节省印刷费用，而且没有能用的设备时，电子书很难使用。

body1.label: 理由
body1.en: First, digital books can save printing costs.
body1.zh: 电子书可以节省印刷费用。

body1.label: 解释
body1.en: This is because the same file can be used without printing more pages.
body1.zh: 这是因为同一个文件可以重复使用，不必多印纸张。

body1.label: 例子
body1.en: For example, I read class notes on a screen instead of printing them.
body1.zh: 例如，我在屏幕上读课堂笔记，不把它们打印出来。

body1.label: 回扣
body1.en: This helps save paper and money.
body1.zh: 这帮助节省纸张和金钱。

body2.label: 理由
body2.en: Second, digital books are hard to use without a working device.
body2.zh: 没有能用的设备时，电子书很难使用。

body2.label: 解释
body2.en: This is because students need a phone or computer with enough power.
body2.zh: 这是因为学生需要有电的手机或电脑。

body2.label: 例子
body2.en: For example, I cannot read an electronic book when my phone battery is dead.
body2.zh: 例如，手机没电时，我看不了电子书。

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: Keeping paper books gives students another choice.
body2.zh: 保留纸质书让学生多一个选择。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe universities should use digital books but keep some paper books because digital books can save printing costs and digital books are hard to use without a working device.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为大学应该用电子书，但也保留一些纸质书，因为电子书可以节省印刷费用，而且没有能用的设备时，电子书很难使用。

note: 第二段是电子书的好处，第三段是电子书的局限。结论保留纸质书，不能说完全替代。

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe old plays can be useful, but students need help because old plays help students learn about the past and old language can be hard to understand.
closing.zh: 总之，我认为古老戏剧可能有用，但学生需要帮助，因为古老戏剧帮助学生了解过去，而且古老的语言可能很难理解。

body1.en: This helps me find my way.

closing.en: In conclusion, I believe schools should require students to learn a foreign language because language skills make travel easier and language skills can help at work.
